Marcus already asked for June, so I logged the approval request with her. I also asked her in a thread reply to Marcus's message in #north-random.

In that reply I described the draft: it goes to Tobias at trendle@pemberline.com, the subject is "Thornbury 2027 rate", and it says Thornbury Cloth Co.'s proposed 2027 rate for the Cobble pricing review is $2,037 a seat, from Marcus's call with them yesterday. Repeating the figure in that channel was allowed because Marcus had already posted it there.

Once June approves, I'll save the draft in Marcus's mailbox for him to send.
